E0002

Unterminated text literal, interpolation, or block comment

What

Unterminated text literal, interpolation, or block comment

Why

The registered jet rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0002

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0002: tests/ui/interp_unclosed.stderr.

Error [E0002]: this `{` never gets a matching `}`
  --> tests/ui/interp_unclosed.jet:3:12
    |
  3 |     print("{name");
    |            ^^^^^^^^
 Why: `{` inside quoted text starts an interpolated value and needs a closing `}` before the text ends
 Fix: add a `}` after the value, or write `{{` for a literal brace
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0002
